steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Spartan society was organised around military preparedness; full citizens (homoioi/equals) were professional soldiers supported by helot labour

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The agoge was the rigorous state education system that trained Spartan boys from age 7 in discipline, endurance and warfare

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Helots were the enslaved population of Messenia who farmed the land; they vastly outnumbered citizens and were constantly controlled by fear

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The krypteia was a secret police of young Spartans who terrorised and killed helots to prevent rebellion

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: Describe the agoge and its purpose. | Q: Why did the Spartans treat the helots so brutally? | Q: How was the Spartan government structured?

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Agoge = state-controlled military training from age 7 Helots: always explain WHY Spartans were brutal (numerical superiority, fear of revolt) Government: 2 kings + 5 ephors + Gerousia + apella — know each role Spartan women: unusual freedom compared to other Greek women
